Car_Assembly

Basic model Assembly

Forklift Assembly

Tip

Different forms are used in different scenarios. For example, the forklift form is suitable for situations requiring servo motor control, while the ultrasonic form requires removing the forklift assembly and replacing it with an ultrasonic module.

POWER

Power supply voltage: 3.5V~5V DC (3 AAA dry cell batteries or 3.6V~3.7V lithium battery)

The Micro-USB cable is only used for powering the motherboard and is insufficient to power the entire vehicle and its peripherals.
